findings.reason: Verified that account-ui i18n.ts uses default i18next interpolation and ThemeResource.getLocalizationTexts serves raw property values without converting {0} to {{0}}, so the new MessageFormat placeholders/choice will render literally in the Account Console while sibling keys still use {{0}}.

Same verified root cause for the admin-ui bundle: admin i18n.ts uses default {{ }} delimiters and no server-side conversion occurs, so admins see raw {0} and choice syntax; duplicate of finding 0 at another site.
Verified the mojo aggregates messages from all files into one failure and the anchor message omits key and file (key param unused), hurting diagnosability but not correctness.
Pattern `</?a[^>]*>` does match <abbr>/<audio> etc., producing a misleading error label, but no unsafe content passes; marginal.
An unchecked RuntimeException on missing _en sibling is real in principle, but all scanned in-repo message directories have an _en counterpart, so no concrete failing case exists here.
Fixture indeed has `</div` without `>`; test still passes, trivial fixture cleanliness issue.
